title: Perpetual check
line: Saving a lost game with checks that never end.

steps.text: You are far behind, and Black threatens mate. But the black king is boxed in by your pawn and knight.
Check with the rook from beside the king. Your pawn guards it.
steps.after: The king had only one square to go to.

steps.text: Check again from the file the king stands on. Your knight guards the rook.
steps.after: Back the king goes: the rook and the pawn cover every other square.

steps.text: And check from the side again.
The same position keeps coming back. Once it has stood three times, the game is a draw: a lost game saved.

summary: When you are lost on material, look for checks the king cannot escape. A position repeated three times is a draw.
